entities.name: Claude Victor-Perrin, Duc de Belluno
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Claude-Victor Perrin, Duke of Belluno was a French military commander who served during the French Revolutionary Wars and the Napoleonic Wars. He was made a Marshal of the Empire in 1807 by Emperor Napoleon I.
